resources.string: Enter a place or full address

Starting requests system split screen with live video and Google Maps navigation, while recording your ride. Use the system divider to resize. Versions before Android 12L use live picture-in-picture instead.
Enter an address, then tap Save favourite
Could not start ride recording. Check location permission and try again.
Not enough location data for a speed chart
Horizontal: elapsed ride time (minutes) · Vertical: km/h
Missing speed intervals stay blank; averages include only valid located intervals.
Cannot open live picture-in-picture. Allow picture-in-picture for Aladdin DashCam in system settings, then try again.
Automatic split screen did not open. Pair Aladdin DashCam and Google Maps in split screen from Recents, or use picture-in-picture from the live More menu.
Return to the app to confirm ride completion on arrival

Confirm the destination first. After leaving its area, a reliable phone GPS fix within %1$d m and %2$d seconds at low speed triggers a return prompt. End the ride manually if GPS is unavailable. Change your destination through this app to keep arrival detection in sync.
Confirm the destination on the map
Destination coordinates or precise location permission are unavailable. Pick a point on the map with precise location enabled, or navigate and end the ride manually.
Tap to return, confirm ride completion and view statistics
Phone GPS indicates you are near %1$s and moving slowly. This is an app estimate, not a Google Maps arrival notification. End this ride and view statistics?
Long-press your destination on the map, then confirm the pin to navigate
Use the map pin you selected for %1$s. Google Maps navigation and this app will use the same coordinates for the destination.
